name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
business_summary: Rampur-based Indian spirits maker: mass IMFL (8PM whisky, Old Admiral brandy, Contessa rum) and a fast-growing prestige & above (P&A) portfolio (Magic Moments vodka, Morpheus brandy, Rampur single malt, Jaisalmer gin). FY26 sales Rs 6,037 cr, EBITDA margin 17%; Sep-26 quarter sales Rs 1,745 cr (+17%), operating margin 20%, PAT Rs 232 cr (+66%). Management raised FY27 P&A volume growth guidance to 30% and says it can sustain a ~20% EBITDA margin (Oct 27-Nov 3, 2026). Karnataka duty cuts more than doubled premium volumes there (Multibagg 2026-11-04); vodka is 6.3% of India's IMFL market.

exposures.mechanism: Grain-based ENA/ rectified spirit ~25% of costs; costs ~80% of sales. +10% grain => costs +2.5% => 2.0% of sales => EBITDA -10% at 20% margin; state price controls limit pass-through to ~40% => -6; persistence 0.5; EV/MCap 1.03 => -3.1.

Glass bottles, cartons, closures ~30% of costs (glass ~15%). +10% => costs +3% for glass+cartons part 1.2% => 1.0% of sales => EBITDA -5%; 40% passthrough => -3; persistence 0.5; => -1.5, widened to -1.8 for energy-driven glass inflation.

Gas fuels glass furnaces and distilleries (~5% of costs direct plus pass-through in glass). +15% => costs +0.75% => EBITDA -3% at 80% cost ratio x 40% pass-through... persistence 0.25 => -0.3. Empirical +1.04 (t=+2.5) has the opposite sign and is unexplained; treated as a spurious co-movement, hence the wide interval.
PET, freight, fuel ~4% of costs: +10% => EBITDA -1.6% => 40% pass-through, persistence 0.5 => -0.4; -0.5 incl. sentiment.
P&A is urban-driven (vodka/gin/single malt), 20% margin with high operating leverage. +5pp urban growth => P&A volume +4% => EBITDA +8% x persistence 0.5 x EV/MCap 1.03 => ~+3.0 (wide: 1y vol 34%).

evidence.note: CNBC TV18: upgrades FY27 premium volume growth guidance to 30%

exposures.mechanism: Structural premiumisation: P&A growing 30% vs regular spirits losing ground (ET 2026-10-27). +1 => mix adds ~1pp margin => EBITDA +5% x persistence 1.0 x 0.6 haircut => +3.0.

evidence.note: ET: premium spirits have a moment as regular volumes lose ground

exposures.mechanism: State excise is the dominant price determinant (taxes ~60-70% of shelf price, model knowledge). +1 adverse change => 3% volume loss in a major state or margin squeeze => EBITDA -6% x persistence 0.5 => -3. Karnataka duty cuts doubled premium volumes there (positive precedent).

evidence.note: Multibagg: Karnataka premium volumes more than double after duty cuts

exposures.mechanism: More ethanol-blending support diverts maize/rice/molasses and lifts ENA/grain input costs; Radico's own distillery capacity gives partial hedge. +1 => grain +4% => EBITDA -4% x 0.5 x hedge 0.4 => -0.8.

evidence.note: model knowledge; no direct disclosure retrieved

exposures.mechanism: Imported malt and some packaging (~8% of costs) vs exports ~10% of revenue (Middle East, UK, Africa). Net ~neutral to slightly positive. Empirical +2.30 (t=1.5) larger but insignificant.

UK duty-free presence (first Indian spirits company at four UK airports, BusinessLine 2026-09-28) and the India-UK trade pact lower spirit tariffs over time (model knowledge). Small export base => +0.4 per +1pp UK demand.

evidence.note: BusinessLine: first Indian spirits firm at four major UK airports

exposures.mechanism: P/E 75, net debt small (interest Rs 11 cr/quarter): +25bp repo => richest-multiple stock in the batch, valuation channel -1.5.

supply_chain.counterparty: Grain and molasses suppliers (FCI rice, maize, own distilleries)
